items.title: fix: populate 'access' table for explicit access grants to read public repositories
items.body:
Fixes #14980.

The purpose of `applyMinVisibility` was to prevent entries in the `access` table which say "user-a can read repo-b" when repo-b is already public, and therefore anyone can read it.  (This logic was present in the `refreshAccesses` codepath when the access table write was refactored in #14243, but, it wasn't applied to all codepaths that wrote `access`.)  This behaviour isn't correct -- Forgejo relies on those records being present for the repo search behaviour on the user dashboard, and for methods like `GetRepoReaders` which "return all users that have explicit read access or higher to the repository".

`applyMinVisibility` has been removed from the access recalc, and an appropriate test added.

Note: no automatic recalculation of the `access` table has been included in this PR.  When users are affected, a team membership change (removal, addition) will be needed to correct the data.  An automatic migration is possible... but... would require cloning a significant amount of logic into a DB migration.  I'm not sure the functional impact is worth it.

items.title: web: fix nil pointer panic in viewPullFiles when compare info is unavailable
items.body:
## Summary

Fixes #14742: a nil pointer dereference panic in `viewPullFiles` when the compare info of a pull request cannot be loaded.

## Root cause

`PrepareMergedViewPullInfo` / `PrepareViewPullInfo` return a nil `*git.CompareInfo` when `GetCompareInfo` fails — for example when the client disconnects before the `git` command returns (the error is `context canceled` / `signal: terminated`, as described in the issue), or when the pull request references git objects that no longer exist. In that case the prepare step reports an error response (`ctx.ServerError`) or flags the pull request as broken and returns `nil`.

The `viewPullFiles` handler dereferenced `prInfo.Commits` while validating the requested commit range *before* reaching its own `prInfo == nil` guard:

```go
// Validate the given commit sha to show (if any passed)
if willShowSpecifiedCommit || willShowSpecifiedCommitRange {
    ...
    for _, commit := range prInfo.Commits {   // <-- nil pointer dereference
```

When loading the single-commit view of a (merged) pull request with a short client timeout, the canceled `git` command produced a nil `prInfo` and the handler panicked (recovered per-request, but logged as a `PANIC` with a stack trace).

`ViewPullCommits` already places the `ctx.Written()` / `prInfo == nil` guard immediately after the prepare calls.

## Fix

Move the `ctx.Written()` / `prInfo == nil` guard in `viewPullFiles` to immediately after the `Prepare*ViewPullInfo` calls, matching the order in `ViewPullCommits`. The handler now returns the 500 error (compare info failure) / 404 (broken pull request) response instead of dereferencing the nil `CompareInfo`.

## Tests

- Added `TestViewPullFilesMissingMergeBase` in `routers/web/repo/pull_test.go`. It points a merged pull request's merge base at a non-existent reference so `GetCompareInfo` fails and `PrepareMergedViewPullInfo` returns nil (the same failure mode a client disconnect triggers), then renders the single-commit view:
  - on the current code it panics with `runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference` at `routers/web/repo/pull.go:939` (verified locally);
  - with this change it passes and a 500 response is returned.
- Ran the full `routers/web/repo/...` package tests (all pass).
- Ran the pull-related integration tests (`TestPull*` in `tests/integration`: `TestListPullCommits`, `TestPullCommitLinks`, `TestPullCommitLinksSHA256`, `TestPullCommitSignature`, `TestPullCompare`) against a SQLite build (all pass).
- `gofumpt` / `golangci-lint run ./routers/web/repo/...` report no issues.

## Checklist

### Compliance

- [x] I confirm that I make this contribution in accordance with Forgejo's AI Agreement. The code change and its regression test were developed with AI coding assistance, and the contribution has been reviewed and verified manually.

### Tests for Go changes

- I added test coverage for Go changes...
  - [x] in their respective `*_test.go` for unit tests.
  - [x] in the `tests/integration` directory if it involves interactions with a live Forgejo server. (No new integration test was necessary; the regression unit test covers the handler directly. Integration tests were run to check for regressions.)

- I ran...
  - [x] `make pr-go` before pushing (equivalent checks run: `gofumpt`, `golangci-lint`, `go vet`, unit and integration tests).

### Documentation

- [x] I did not document these changes and I do not expect someone else to do it. (Internal bug fix; no configuration or user-facing behavior change beyond no longer panicking.)

items.title: [v17.0/forgejo] git(config): replace regexp escaping with --fixed-value flag
items.body:
**Backport:** https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/15053

Fixes #15048 (macOS only failure apparently: I am not sure a backport is warranted in such case)

## Use `--fixed-value`

The `--fixed-value` flag is cleaner than regex escaping and should fix the issue reported by @javerous in #15048.
The tests already covers this code: checkout each commit and run `go test ./modules/git -run=TestGitConfig` to see the 2 tests failing and how they are being fixed one after the other.
